lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately four horizontal rows of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters (blobs) are visible posterior to the gill slits, with the highest-intensity clusters located in the mid-flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of circular blobs, creating a grid-like lattice of anchor nodes across the visible lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible across the upper-mid flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient transition from high luminance (above) to shadow (below).

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a high spatial density of small-diameter, high-luminance spots that are significantly more compact and irregular than the larger blobs observed on the main lateral flank.
